title: YS-swap zero-haircut floor (story-067) is silently disabled on a leg-1 resume: the forced re-gather overwrites leg1-stakers.json totalStaked with the post-drain 0, so SkimAndLeg1 persists preMigBooked=0 and the step-9 cleanup floor degrades to require(principalOf >= 0) — vacuous
rootCause: story-067 added a zero-haircut FLOOR in PostMigrationCleanup: require(principalOf(token, original) >= preMigBooked) per token. preMigBooked is persisted by SkimAndLeg1Migration from leg1-stakers.json's .totalStaked snapshot (SkimAndLeg1:393-402, the final writes in run()). That snapshot is produced by gather-migration-inputs.js, which reads totalStaked LIVE from on-chain poolInfo[3]. SkimAndLeg1's count-staleness preflight (lines 187-194) hard-reverts with 'stale ... re-run gather' whenever leg1-stakers.json .count != on-chain stakerCount. After leg1 drains the pool (stakerCount->0, totalStaked->0) and the broadcast halts BEFORE the preMigBooked persistence block, a resume FORCES the operator to re-gather; the re-gather overwrites the snapshot's totalStaked with the post-drain value 0. On the SkimAndLeg1 re-run, the totalStaked==on-chain preflight (lines 204-218) is SKIPPED because stakerCount==0, so the script persists preMigBooked = 0. The author's own code comment (lines 388-392) asserts a resume 're-persists the IDENTICAL value instead of the post-drain 0' — the forced re-gather makes that assumption false.
impact: Value leak to migrated stakers. The story-067 floor is the SOLE end-to-end protection that a two-leg migration never shortchanges a staker: ResetAndRewire's step-6 post-assert is a one-sided '<=' over-credit CEILING (does not catch under-credit), and SkimAndLeg1's Phase-4 _prefundShortfall only WARNs (never reverts) when injected < shortfall. With preMigBooked silently zeroed on the resume path, the step-9 floor degrades to require(principalOf >= 0) — always true — so a real haircut (Phase-4 under-prefund + sub-swept principal) flows through step 9 uncaught and reaches users who withdraw less than their booked principal. No malice and no concurrency required: it is reachable through the documented resume runbook (the script's own error message directs the operator to re-gather). On the CURRENT autoDOLA/autoUSD ERC4626 strategies the realized haircut magnitude is redeem-rounding dust (~0.024% round-trip); the finding's severity is the silent disablement of the protection, not the dust.
attackPath: 1. The saga's leg-1 fails or is interrupted (an explicitly supported resume/partial-run path).
2. The operator follows the script's own error message and re-gathers migration inputs (gather-migration-inputs.js).
3. The forced re-gather reads the now-drained on-chain state and overwrites leg1-stakers.json totalStaked with the post-drain value 0.
4. SkimAndLeg1Migration persists preMigBooked = 0 (totalStaked==chain preflight skipped on stakerCount==0).
5. Step-9 PostMigrationCleanup floor require(ysV2.principalOf >= preMigBooked) becomes require(principalOf >= 0) — always true.
6. A real staker haircut (Phase-4 under-prefund only WARNs; ResetAndRewire ceiling is one-sided) now passes the gate uncaught and stakers are shorted principal silently.
recommendation: Persist preMigBooked guarded so a resume re-uses the ORIGINAL pre-drain snapshot, not the post-drain 0, OR make the floor read the pre-drain booked value. Concrete options: (1) In SkimAndLeg1, before persisting, read back any existing .dolaPreMigBooked/.usdcPreMigBooked and refuse to OVERWRITE a previously-recorded non-zero value with a smaller one (idempotent re-persist of the original). (2) Hard-require preMigBooked > 0 in PostMigrationCleanup (lines 247-256) so a zeroed anchor fails loud instead of passing vacuously (mirror how YS-22 rejects an unrecorded pauser). (3) Source preMigBooked from a first-run-only snapshot file (premig-booked.json) that is NEVER overwritten on resume, gated on its own absence. (4) Make _prefundShortfall HARD-REVERT on injected < shortfall rather than WARN, removing reliance on the single downstream gate. Also fix the comparand per YS-32 (compare against poolInfo.totalStaked, not buffer-inflated principalOf).

poc.note: Anchor-zeroing mechanism corroborated by PoC_YS25_PreMigBookedResumeZeroing.t.sol (2/2 PASS): first-run floor catches a 1% haircut; resume re-gather zeroes preMigBooked and the same haircut passes the gate vacuously.

severityRationale: Medium (capped, not High): a value leak with stated assumptions and an external/sequence requirement (the resume path) — the textbook C4 Medium shape. Not High because (a) no direct theft and no attacker — exploitation is a coincidence of a supported operational path with a haircut condition, and (b) on the current autoDOLA/autoUSD ERC4626 strategies the actual haircut magnitude is redeem-rounding dust (~0.024% round-trip). Per the project's in-motion/unmatured user-value guidance, this caps at Medium. Not downgraded to Low because the finding is the silent disablement of the protocol's SOLE end-to-end user-protection invariant on the path most likely to produce a haircut — recall over report-tidiness (Law 1).
footgunRationale: Non-obvious footgun: the operator is following the script's OWN re-gather instruction, and the author's OWN comment asserts the re-persist is identical — a competent operator would be surprised the documented resume silently disarms the safety floor. Safe-config / fix guidance: on resume, do not derive preMigBooked from re-gathered post-drain state; persist/preserve the original pre-migration anchor.
faithfulnessRationale: Tagged faithfulness:true (Law 2): story-067's stated behaviour is a zero-haircut guarantee for migrated stakers; the resume path silently breaks that guaranteed behaviour. Route to the spec-conformance report as F-XX in ADDITION to its Medium HM listing (Law 1 keeps the real severity — not buried in QA/gas noise).
threeLawFraming: Law 1 (security) sets the real severity (Medium value-leak); Law 2 (faithfulness) adds the spec-conformance cross-ref; Law 3 (owner-trust) confirms it is an in-scope non-obvious footgun, not malicious-admin noise.

Complementary to YS-32 (WrongComparand on a clean run). Also relatedTo 88331e64 (YS-30 prefund integer truncation) — together a systemic silent-haircut path.
